prompt: Which was the third Asian country to report a case of clade Ib mpox during the most recent outbreak?
answer: China was the third Asian country to report a clade Ib mpox case. Thailand reported Asia’s first case in August 2024, followed by India in September 2024; China reported its first cases in January 2025 (with the initial infection identified in December 2024).
